lines: Write down three good things from *today.*
A good *coffee.* A message from a friend. A moment of *quiet.*
But your brain is trained to look for *problems.*
It scans all day for what went *wrong.*
#So you fall asleep with a head full of *worry.*
It means not letting the hard stuff be the *only* stuff.
You'll start noticing the good things *during* the day.
Because you know you'll need to write them *down.*
#And slowly, the same life starts to feel *different.*
end: Try it tonight. Send this to someone who needs it.

post.title: Before You Sleep, Try This for 7 Days
post.caption: Your brain hunts for problems. Teach it to hunt for good. 🌙
post.first_comment: Drop one good thing from your day 👇
